text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my all, but it ended up
as a non-buono result...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "I couldn't bring a smile to myself, the fans who came to watch, or Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm de~finitely gonna make everyone smile!
From here on out, it's time to do my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm de~finitely gonna make everyone smile!
From here on out, it's time to do my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm definitely winning the next race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure your heart is fully satisfied too, Trainer,
so let's share the biggest, brightest smiles together☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll show you I can become much, much stronger than I am now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... No, Boss!
Put me through the wringer, please!
